start: Android phone, workout started from a routine: Bench Press 3 working sets, last time 35 kg × 11

steps.action: Go to the home screen and pull down the shade
user_sees: One ongoing card titled 'Bench Press' with the workout clock (e.g. 'Bench Press 4:15')
Text 'Set 1 of 3 · 35 kg × 11'
A 'Complete set' button
The exercise picture
must_not: No card while a workout is open
A clock that starts from 0:00 again
Numbers other than the row's typed values or grey hint

steps.action: Tap 'Complete set' without opening the app
user_sees: The rest starts
The card moves on to 'Set 2 of 3 · …'
must_not: The app opens
The set saved with numbers other than the card showed
Two sets ticked by one tap

steps.action: Tick the last working set from the card
user_sees: 'All sets done · Finish' with no button
must_not: 'Complete set' still shown

user_sees: Every set ticked from the card is ticked in the workout with the card's numbers
must_not: A tick from the card lost
A tick saved twice

start: Workout open on the phone, watch app connected

user_sees: Three lines: 'Set 3 of 5', last time's numbers for that set (e.g. '60 kg × 8'), and what Done saves
must_not: Lines for another set than the phone card names
Weight in another unit than the member's

steps.action: Turn the dial and tap Done on the watch
user_sees: The phone's workout ticks that set with the watch's numbers and the rest starts
must_not: Different numbers on phone and watch
The set ticked twice

start: Workout with 2 warm-ups, then a superset of two exercises

steps.action: Look at the card before any tick
user_sees: 'Warm-up 1 of 2 · 20 kg × 10'
must_not: Warm-ups counted in 'Set 1 of …'

steps.action: Tick a set of the first superset exercise
user_sees: The card names the partner exercise and its set
must_not: The card stays on the first exercise mid-superset
A rest started mid-superset

start: Workout with no exercises, then a row with no reps typed, no target and no last time

steps.action: Pull down the shade with no exercise added
user_sees: Title the workout name or 'Workout in progress'
'Add an exercise to start' with no button
must_not: A 'Complete set' button

steps.action: Add the exercise with the empty row and look at the card
user_sees: 'Set 1 of 3 · add reps in the app' with no 'Complete set'
must_not: An empty set saved from the card
A button that does nothing

start: Workout open with the card up

steps.action: Pause the workout in the app
user_sees: The card text starts 'Paused · '
The clock stands still
must_not: The clock keeps counting while paused

steps.action: Resume, then tick a set, then untick it in the app
user_sees: The clock runs on from the paused time
The card goes back to that set
must_not: The card stays on the next set after the untick

user_sees: The card goes away
The watch says 'Workout saved'
must_not: The card left up after Finish

steps.action: Start a new workout and discard it
user_sees: The card goes away
must_not: 'Workout saved' after a discard

start: Workout open, phone locked on a table

user_sees: The card with exercise name, set and weights
must_not: Body weight, notes or photos on the card
Another member's data
